title: Welcome to OrionMail
summary: The first OrionMail release brings your Google accounts together in a customizable Windows desktop workspace, with conversations, Smart Actions and control over how you read, organize and send mail.

items.title: Google accounts and unified inbox
items.text: Connect up to three Google accounts. Switch accounts from the sidebar or read All inboxes with account, unread and starred filters. Account markers identify each message’s owner.

items.title: Account identities and preferences
items.text: Set account aliases, colours and startup selection; review account health and unread totals. Use device preferences with account-specific overrides where supported.

items.title: Conversations
items.text: Group linked replies into expandable message cards, with quoted history hidden until requested. Reply metadata keeps unrelated messages and accounts separate.

items.title: Compose and drafts
items.text: Compose formatted mail with attachments, contact suggestions, signatures and default Cc/Bcc preferences. Save drafts, choose a sending account, reply, reply all, forward, or start a fresh message to a sender.

items.title: Tags, pins, stars and snooze
items.text: Create and edit tags, organize messages, pin or star important mail, and snooze messages until a preset or custom date and time. Quick actions are available in the reader toolbar and context menus.

items.title: Smart Actions
items.text: Locally extract verification codes, meeting links and invitations, order and delivery details, and travel information from supported message formats. Choose which action categories appear.

items.title: Themes and reading layouts
items.text: Choose light, dark or system theme, an accent colour, and side-by-side, stacked or Minimal layout. Minimal keeps two panes and opens messages in the full second pane. Customize density, previews, avatars, dates and reading text size.

items.title: Notifications and focus
items.text: Configure desktop alerts, sounds, notification previews, folder alerts, Important-only alerts, Do not disturb and scheduled quiet hours. Show unread counts on the taskbar for the active account or all accounts.

items.title: Local mail and storage
items.text: Read downloaded content offline, configure body retention and cache budgets, choose an attachment download folder, inspect measured storage usage, and clear downloaded content. Read/star changes persist locally for retry when connectivity returns.

items.title: Windows integration
items.text: Use the system tray, startup preferences and mailto links. Register OrionMail as a Windows mail app. Windows Hello app lock, remote-content blocking and external-link confirmation provide additional controls.

items.title: Updates and release information
items.text: Check for updates at launch and hourly while running, or manually from About. Choose Update now or Later; verified Tauri update signatures protect the update download. Browse categorized release notes and a paginated What’s New tour.

items.title: Privacy, terms and open source
items.text: Access themed Privacy, Terms, MIT License and third-party notices pages from the app. Original OrionMail code is released under the MIT License.

items.title: Navigation and responsiveness
items.text: A virtualized message list, local caching and bounded background fetching keep navigation responsive. Sidebar tooltips, keyboard shortcuts and account folder shortcuts help you reach common actions.

items.title: Message rendering
items.text: Conversation cards use compact spacing and direct dark-mode text for simple replies. Quoted history stays collapsed and rich message layouts retain their own rendering path.

items.title: Unread state and offline intent
items.text: Read/star changes save their local state together with a durable queue entry, notify unread-count consumers, and survive transport failures. Stale account-switch responses cannot update another mailbox.

items.title: Account boundaries
items.text: Message bodies, actions, drafts, tags, pins and snoozes retain their account ownership. Unsaved-work guards protect account changes and update installation.

items.title: Windows and Google only
items.text: This release supports Windows and Google accounts, with a maximum of three connected accounts. Other platforms and providers are not available.

items.title: Local organization and offline limits
items.text: Pins and snoozes are device-local; snooze does not sync to Gmail. Overdue messages return when OrionMail runs. Uncached bodies, new attachments and sending require connectivity. All inboxes searches downloaded headers and previews.

items.title: Unsigned Windows publisher
items.text: The installer has no Windows publisher certificate and may show Unknown publisher or SmartScreen warnings. Tauri updater signatures are separate and remain required.

items.title: Features still to come
items.text: Settings marked Coming Soon are not implemented, including automatic idle/session locking, sender blocking controls, date-limited sync, automatic attachment downloads and custom shortcut bindings.

whatsNew.title: Meet your new inbox.
whatsNew.text: Connect up to three Google accounts, switch by alias and colour, or bring them together in All inboxes. Read with account markers and account, unread and starred filters.

image.alt: OrionMail one home for your accounts interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Every reply, in its place.
whatsNew.text: Read linked replies together, expand individual messages and reveal quoted history only when you need it. Reply, reply all and forward stay tied to the message you choose.

image.alt: OrionMail follow the conversation interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Write from the right account.
whatsNew.text: Use formatted text, attachments, contact suggestions and signatures. Choose the sender when several accounts are connected; replies use the account that received the message. Draft-saving guards protect your work.

image.alt: OrionMail from draft to sent interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Tag it. Pin it. Snooze it.
whatsNew.text: Organize with tags and stars, pin important mail and snooze messages until a time you choose. Reach actions through the reader toolbar, right-click menus and sidebar folder shortcuts.

image.alt: OrionMail a place for everything interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Less copying. More doing.
whatsNew.text: Copy verification codes, open meeting links and find supported order, delivery and travel details in locally extracted Smart Actions. Turn individual categories on or off.

image.alt: OrionMail useful details at a glance interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Your theme. Your layout.
whatsNew.text: Choose light, dark or system theme and an accent colour. Read side by side, below the list, or in Minimal mode, where a full-width message replaces the list until you go back.

image.alt: OrionMail make it yours interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Make room for focus.
whatsNew.text: Choose alert folders, notification previews and sounds. Enable Do not disturb or set daily quiet hours. Keep track of unread mail with per-account counts and a Windows taskbar badge.

image.alt: OrionMail mail at your pace interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Keep downloaded mail close.
whatsNew.text: Cached mail stays readable offline. Read and star changes are saved locally for later sync. Adjust cache retention and budgets, view measured storage usage and choose where attachments are saved.

image.alt: OrionMail local and responsive interface illustration.

whatsNew.title: Decide what your mail can load.
whatsNew.text: Block remote content until you allow it, confirm external links and use Windows Hello app lock. Read the Privacy Policy, Terms, MIT License and bundled third-party notices in About.

whatsNew.title: Stay up to date, on your terms.
whatsNew.text: OrionMail checks for updates on launch and hourly while running. Choose Update now or Later. After an update, take the What’s New tour and browse the full release notes in About.

image.alt: OrionMail ready for what’s next interface illustration.
